annotations.title: Compare Filing Item With Prior Year

description:
What changed in one Item of a 10-K, 10-Q or 20-F since the same filing a year earlier
(new and dropped risk factors, rewritten MD&A, legal proceedings...), shown to the user
as a marked-up comparison in the viewer.

You get every added, removed and changed paragraph as text: inside a changed one,
[-old words-] and {+new words+}. Unchanged paragraphs are left out of your copy. The
prior filing is the company's same form filed closest to one year before (a 10-Q is
compared with the same quarter last year); pass prior_accession_number to choose another.
Changes are numbered; a long list comes in pages: the last line says to call
more_item_changes for the next one.

Args:
    accession_number: The newer filing (10-K, 10-Q or 20-F)
    item: The Item, by number or name ("1A", "Risk Factors", "7", "MD&A", "3")
    part: 10-Q only: "I" or "II" when the number exists in both parts ("1", "2"); Risk Factors is Part II Item 1A
    prior_accession_number: Optional. The older filing to compare with
name: compare_filing_item
title: Compare Filing Item With Prior Year
